title: Cafe in Bellevue
assumptions: The company still has to be formed (an LLC) unless an entity is named. Hires staff. Builds out the space. No new exterior sign (signage: false).

items.name: Certificate of Formation (Washington LLC)
items.note: Not read on an official page in this pass.

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.note: IRS: "You never have to pay a fee for an EIN."

items.name: Washington State Business License (Business Licensing Service)
items.agency: Washington Department of Revenue, Business Licensing Service

items.name: Unemployment insurance and workers' comp accounts (opened through the business license)
items.agency: Washington ESD and L&I (through the Business Licensing Service)
items.note: ESD and L&I "automatically create your State Unemployment Insurance (SUI) and Workers Compensation (WC) accounts" from the business license application.

items.name: Washington State Food Worker Card for employees
items.agency: Washington State Department of Health (local health departments)
items.note: Up to 14 days of work before the card, with employer training; first card valid 2 years.

items.name: Food establishment plan review
items.agency: Public Health, Seattle and King County

items.name: Permanent food service business permit
items.agency: Public Health, Seattle and King County
items.match: (food (service )?business permit|food service).*(king county)|(king county).*(food (service )?business permit|food service)

items.name: Bellevue business license
items.agency: City of Bellevue Finance, Tax Division
items.quote: A business must have a Washington State Business License for all locations before applying for a Bellevue business license.
items.note: "The registration fee for licenses obtained in 2026 is $119."

items.name: Building permit for the tenant improvement
items.match: (building permit|tenant improvement|build-?out|construction permit).*(bellevue)|(bellevue).*(building permit|tenant improvement|build-?out|construction permit)
items.quote: Construction, tenant improvements, and certain land use activities require building and land-use permits from the Development Services Department .

order.why: IRS: "form your entity through the secretary of state before you apply for an EIN."
Plan review approval before the permit to operate.
The state business license before the Bellevue license.
